annotations.title: Bridge statistics (Across, LayerZero, Stargate, Wormhole among Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP)

description: Across, LayerZero OFT / Stargate V2 and Wormhole (Token Bridge, NTT) transfers among Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and OP Mainnet, counted from ASPERN’s stored index (BridgeTransfer, since 2026-11-24; only routes among the four). Per bridge lane (Across, LayerZero OFT, Stargate V2, Wormhole Token Bridge, Wormhole NTT): Tx (each transfer counted once at its source), USD (the source amount at the source hour from DefiLlama; unpriced transfers counted in Tx only), filled, median and p90 seconds to the destination event, and per UTC day (`read` false before the index first read a chain: not read, never zero). Per route (all 12 ordered pairs) Tx and USD, split by lane. `scale` is ONE scale across every lane and day so bars compare dollars. `index.state`: read, not_yet_read (the job has not run: nothing says there was no traffic) or unavailable. Circle CCTP is counted apart by cross_chain_stats; one transfer: cross_chain_trace. Never claims the addresses share an owner, that an AI agent acted, or that anything was autonomous. FREE.

days.description: Window in days, default 30, at most 365.

name: bridge_stats

index.description: state (read | not_yet_read | unavailable), says, readSince, since per chain, job (enabled, everyMinutes, lastRunAt).

lanes.description: Per lane: version, bridge, label, mark, transfers, usd, unpriced, filled, medianSeconds, p90Seconds, perDay [day, read, transfers, usd, filled].

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

routes.description: Per route: route, sourceNetwork, destinationNetwork, covered, transfers, usd, byLane [version, transfers, usd].

says.description: One sentence, or why there are no figures.

scale.description: shared (true), maxDayUsd, maxDayTransfers, maxRouteUsd, says: one scale for every lane and route.

totals.description: transfers (Tx), usd, unpriced, filled over the window.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

window.description: from, through, days: every UTC day of the window.
